title: Recurrent fractures in childhood — referral pathway
who_baseline: WHO IMCI / child health referral principles (generic baseline)
Demo adaptation: national child-health screening (RBSK-style) referral to District Early Intervention Centre
default_action: Routine follow-up; reassess after any further fracture

rules.title: Fresh fracture with deformity or open wound

source.baseline: Generic emergency triage principle: acute deformity / open fracture needs same-day care

rules.title: Recurrent low-trauma fractures in a child
rules.action: Non-urgent pediatric evaluation for bone fragility

source.baseline: Recurrent low-trauma fractures warrant evaluation for underlying bone fragility
source.local: IN-DEMO pack §7.3: refer to district pediatrics

rules.title: Recurrent low-trauma fractures with associated features
rules.action: Non-urgent referral to pediatric genetics / bone clinic

source.baseline: Associated features (blue sclera, family history, hearing loss) suggest a heritable bone-fragility pathway
source.local: IN-DEMO pack §7.4: pathway confirmation by pediatrician before tertiary referral

text.en: Did these fractures happen after a big fall or accident — or with very little force?
text.hi: क्या ये हड्डियाँ किसी बड़ी चोट या दुर्घटना से टूटीं — या बहुत हल्की चोट से?
text.bn: হাড়গুলো কি বড় কোনো দুর্ঘটনায় ভেঙেছে — নাকি সামান্য আঘাতেই?

text.en: Is there a fresh injury now — a bent limb or an open wound?
text.hi: क्या अभी कोई ताज़ा चोट है — मुड़ा हुआ हाथ/पैर या खुला घाव?
text.bn: এখন কি কোনো নতুন আঘাত আছে — বাঁকা হাত/পা বা খোলা ক্ষত?

text.en: Look at the whites of his eyes. Do they look blue or grey?
text.hi: उसकी आँखों के सफ़ेद हिस्से को देखिए। क्या वह नीला या स्लेटी दिखता है?
text.bn: ওর চোখের সাদা অংশটা দেখুন। সেটা কি নীলচে বা ধূসর দেখাচ্ছে?

prior_modifiers.reason: Short stature reported with recurrent fractures

text.en: Has anyone in the family had many broken bones?
text.hi: क्या परिवार में किसी की हड्डियाँ बार-बार टूटी हैं?
text.bn: পরিবারে কারও কি বারবার হাড় ভেঙেছে?

text.en: Does he have any problems with hearing?
text.hi: क्या उसे सुनने में कोई परेशानी है?
text.bn: ওর কি শুনতে কোনো অসুবিধা হয়?
